name: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Implement a data re-uploading classifier in P
task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Implement a data re-uploading classifier in PennyLane (single qubit, 3 layers of RZ(x)RY(w) blocks) to fit the function f(x)=cos(1 x) on [0, 2pi] with mean-squared-error training; report final loss. Give one complete script that runs end-to-end on its own and prints the outcome.
